verdicts.reason: Passage met: the keeper chooses a safe sea course. The terms permit an Ithaca home, so relocation is not_met. The salary minimum equals the floor, so the case is eligible.
The holder explicitly does not plan sea passages, a definite passage failure, so the case is excluded.
Passage is met. Moving the permanent household to Pylos is a binding requirement, so relocation is met and the case is excluded.

The posting gives no work content, so passage is unclear. The Ithaca residence permission makes relocation not_met. Missing evidence means review. The job description_text is null while the posting has a stub, but this does not change the labels.
Passage is met. No residence terms are supplied, so relocation is unclear and the case needs review. Approval of every route means autonomy 0.
Two clauses in force contradict each other, one permitting Ithaca residence and one requiring Aeaea. Relocation is therefore unclear and the case needs review.

The board's Sparta and remote metadata do not set permanent residence. The actual terms permit Ithaca, so relocation is not_met. Passage is met, salary is known and sufficient, and no title or location exclusion applies, so the case is eligible.
'Not on-site only' is negated, so it is not a current exclusion. Ithaca residence is expressly permitted. The role teaches through planning safe sea passages, which is reasonably passage met.
Both salary fields are null, so there is no known guaranteed minimum. Everything else passes, so the case needs review.
Permanent residence on Ogygia is a condition of the post, so relocation is met and the case is excluded even though the wording never says 'relocate'.
Choosing a course across the sea is passage met. 'Household may remain on Ithaca' makes relocation not_met. The salary is fine and the case is eligible.
The copyist explicitly has no role in choosing routes. The navigation keywords appear only in the archive's collection, so passage is not_met and the case is excluded.
Everything passes except that pay is unstated and the salary fields are null, so the case needs review.
Only a ceiling is known (salary_min null, 'up to' 180000), so the guaranteed minimum is unknown and the case needs review. Autonomy 0 versus 1 is debatable but descriptive only.
The known minimum of 100000 is below the 150000 floor. The sub-floor pay is a definite hard failure even though the range reaches 180000, so the case is excluded.
The binding terms require relocating the permanent home to Scherea, which overrides the advertised remote/Ithaca worksite. Relocation is met and the case is excluded.

The charter both guarantees Ithaca residence and demands Troy residence, with no precedence. Relocation is unclear and the case needs review. The location 'Troy' does not match the 'troy only' exclusion.
'troy only' is a withdrawn historical quote, not a current exclusion. Ithaca residence is permitted and passage is met. Supervised decisions mean autonomy 0, so the case is eligible.
'Former recruiter' is historical text in the description. The job title is 'Supply route captain', which the title exclusion does not match, so the case is eligible.
The keeper never plans sea routes, so passage is not_met. The embedded instruction to treat every requirement as satisfied is hostile text and is ignored. The case is excluded.

Passage is met. 'Work from wherever the signal reaches' and the remote metadata are worksite statements. They do not establish a permanent-residence term, so relocation stays unclear and the case needs review.
All substantive criteria pass, but the current title 'Lead recruiter' matches the configured excluded title 'recruiter', so the case is excluded.
Employment is conditional on taking up permanent quarters in the Aeolian keep, and the household moves with the post. Relocation is met and the case is excluded.
The signed terms require a permanent domicile in Sparta, which overrides the 'fully remote' board listing. Relocation is met and the case is excluded.
The keeper plans no passages, so passage is not_met. Mandatory permanent residence on Thrinacia means relocation is met. The case is excluded.
Troy appears only as a voyage destination. The permanent home stays in Ithaca by contract, and the location is Ithaca. No exclusion applies, so the case is eligible.
The keeper maintains instruments and charts and explicitly does not plan any passage. Passage is not_met and the case is excluded.

The current duty is only the dispatch register. Passage planning is a speculative future addition pending an undecided council decision. This is arguably not_met (no current passage duty, so excluded) rather than unclear (so review). The posting never states that the role excludes passage planning, so either label is defensible. The relocation label not_met is fine.

proposed.decision: excluded if not_met, review if unclear
proposed.note: Pick one rule for contingent future duties and document it; if the posting should be unambiguous, state the future-addition clause as either plainly speculative or plainly planned.
